findings.evidence: Line 158 states `∃ b : Basis (Fin 2) ℚ K, ⇑b = ![1, x] ∧ ∀ i, IsIntegral ℤ (b i)`; the naming guide says theorem names should describe the conclusion, read from the conclusion outward.
findings.fix: Rename it to describe the vector/basis conclusion, e.g. `exists_basis_eq_one_self_of_notMem_range_of_isIntegral` or `exists_basis_eq_vecCons_of_notMem_range_of_isIntegral`, and update the two call sites.
findings.issue: `exists_basis_eq_fin_two_of_notMem_range_of_isIntegral` names the implementation index `Fin 2`, but the conclusion is that there exists a basis whose coercion is `![1, x]` and whose entries are integral; `eq_fin_two` does not describe an equality in the statement.

summary: One public helper name does not describe its conclusion in standard Mathlib terms; the worked-example theorem names otherwise match their statements.
